description: Find substitute products on CacheBy for a reagent by CAS number — same substance from other brands/specs, sorted by price ascending. Use when a product is out of stock or to find a cheaper equivalent. To get a product page URL, call search_products with the partNumber.

casNumber.description: CAS registry number of the reagent

excludeProductId.description: Product id to exclude (the one being replaced)

name: get_substitutes
title: Find substitutes
